item.title: Israel Blocks Turkey’s Hopes of Rejoining the F-35 Program
item.description: Amid President Trump's expressed interest in reintegrating Turkey into the F-35 program (following its 2019 expulsion over S-400 purchases), Israel's stance highlights the multinational nature of the program and its leverage to protect regional security interests. Relations between Israel and Turkey remain strained, while Israel-Greece defense ties are at historic highs. item.title: US Overhauls Childhood Vaccine Schedule in Major 2026 Shift
item.description: The US has overhauled its childhood vaccine schedule in 2026, reducing routine recommendations from 17 to 11 diseases. Vaccines for rotavirus, influenza, hepatitis A, hepatitis B, and meningococcal are now risk-based only — a major shift under HHS Secretary RFK Jr. Australia maintains a broader universal program.
